title: Спор о блюде  (Dispute Over the Dish)

segments.t: Barinov has spotted the veal rolls from his own kitchen on the menu of the rival restaurant, and he storms over to its chef, Elena, to accuse her of stealing the dish. Russian first, then we'll take it apart.
'Hold it right there.' The basic form of 'stand' is used as a command, like a guard's 'freeze!'. It's bossy by itself.
'What's the matter?' Russian says 'in what is the matter', with 'matter' a very common word. It's a fixed phrase.
'You stole our dish.' 'Stole' finishes with 'li', because he says 'you' in the plural. 'Our dish' is neuter, with the 'e' ending.
'We invented it ourselves.' 'Ourselves' goes first, which puts weight on it. 'It' is the same as 'him', a quirk for neuter nouns.
'I knew it.' The line is 'I so and knew', with the 'so and' as 'I thought as much'. 'Knew' ends in the masculine 'l'.
'You can't do anything yourselves.' 'Nothing' and 'not' appear together, and Russian demands both. 'Yourselves' sits at the end.
'Look at this date.' 'Look at' needs a small word for 'at'. 'Date' is a borrowed word, with an 'u' ending.
'Well, well.' The word 'nu' means 'well', and said twice it becomes a skeptical drawl. The tone matters more than the meaning.
'Give me the menu, please.' The command is the polite plural. 'To me' is how Russian says 'me' here.
'Can you see well?' 'Well' goes before 'see', and the whole question is a jab. The polite 'you' makes it sound sharper, not softer.
'Yes, fine.' The word is literally 'normally', and it is the standard reply when you're asked how you are. Barinov gives it through his teeth.
'Sorry.' The word means 'excuse me' and is polite. It is a rare thing to hear from Barinov. Let's finish by hearing it all again.
Elena has the date on her side, and Barinov has to back down. As you listen again, notice that 'stoyat'' is just the basic form of the word, used as a stern command. See you next time!

lines.fragment: Да вы украли у нас сезонное блюдо от шефа.
Мы не успели его в меню вставить, как мы его уже украли.
А я так и знал, что вы ничего не можете сами, паразиты.
А я так и знал, что вы ничего не можете сами, паразиты.
Посмотрите, пожалуйста, на дату утверждения меню.
